initialExam.title: UPSC Indian Statistical Service (IES/ISS) 2026
initialExam.description: Indian Economic Service / Indian Statistical Service combined exam for economists and statisticians in central government. Exam conducted June 19-21, 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree with Statistics/Mathematical Statistics/Applied Statistics as one of the subjects
initialExam.syllabus: Statistics Paper-I to IV covering Probability, Statistical Methods, Linear Models, Sampling, Design of Experiments, Econometrics, etc.
initialExam.examPattern: 6 papers (1000 marks total) - General English, General Studies, Statistics I-IV + Interview (200 marks). Each paper: 3 hours.
initialExam.jobRole: Statistical Officer in Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
initialExam.careerGrowth: Junior Statistical Officer → Senior Statistical Officer → Director → Joint Secretary.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit upsc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
